title: Chapter 349 The Origin Of Wine
content:
Chapter 349 The Origin Of Wine

Soon, a small glass of spiritual wine was placed in front of Mr. Jiang.

The rich aroma of wine penetrated his nose, making Old Master Jiang unable to help but start to intoxicate.

Unexpectedly, this old guy named Lin still has such a good product hidden.

Mr. Jiang secretly glanced at Linye on the other end, raised his mouth slightly, then raised his glass and took a sip.

Well, it's great!

When the spirit wine was in his mouth, Mr. Jiang suddenly felt an unprecedented feeling.

The blood veins in my body were swelling and my pores were wide open.

The head of the Li family on the other side also noticed the change in Mr. Jiang's expression and his heart suddenly moved slightly.

This wine is really so good.

Unable to bear the spirit, the head of the Li family raised his glass and drank it gently.

Because he has always been inconsistent with the Lin family, he is preparing to show a disdainful face before drinking even if the wine is great.

Nothing else is just disgusting the Lin family.

It's better to make a few more ridicule, that's it?

But when a sip of spiritual wine entered his mouth, an unprecedented sense of shock suddenly surged from the soles of his feet and soared straight into the sky.

The head of the Li family was shocked and couldn't help but be stunned, murmured, "What kind of wine is this?"

Lin Ye, who was standing beside him, heard this, with a little disdain on the corner of his mouth.

You wild boar, today I will ask Mr. Lu for your blessing, so that you can taste what fine bran is.

But Lu Daosheng was on the side, and he didn't dare to say too much.

He had to chuckled a few times, "Brother Li just drink it, it's just a little wine."

"Is it possible? Don't you have a Li family?"

Hearing this, the head of the Li family thrust his face and stopped talking.

Next to Lu Daosheng, Jiang Xiaoxiao saw all this and then said weakly to Lu Daosheng: "Brother Sheng, that old guy won't add stimulant to the wine, right?"

Stimulant. .

Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled, but it seemed like it was almost the same.

But spiritual energy is not as bad as stimulants, it can really improve a person's overall strength.

If enough, it can even make people truly cultivate immortality.

Lu Daosheng lowered his eyebrows slightly and looked at the jar of wine. If this is the case, it would definitely not be enough.

"Mr. Lu, don't you try it?"

At this time, Lin Ye asked Lu Daosheng with a smirk.

Everyone had drunk, but only Lu Daosheng was still sitting upright, watching everyone drink, which made Linye feel a little nervous.

Could it be that this adult doesn’t like his little wine?

After careful consideration, Forestry understood.

This adult probably has reached an unimaginable level. His little wine is probably like dirt in the eyes of the other party.

Lu Daosheng didn't know what Lin Ye was thinking. Looking at Lin Ye's flattering look, Lu Daosheng slowly raised the wine glass in front of him.

Seeing this, Lin Ye looked panicked and flattered.

"Mr. Lu, Lin has a cup of wine. I have offended him before."

Linye quickly raised his wine glass, arched towards Lu Daosheng, and then drank it all in one go.

It's so cool!

Without exception, Linye is also extremely comfortable when he enters the mouth of Lingjiu.

Although it was not the first time he drank it, he never drank so much in one breath. He savored it little by little.

After all, this jar of wine can be less drunk.

If it weren't for Lu Daosheng's defiant methods today, he would never have taken out the wine.

Looking at Linye like this, Lu Daosheng smiled without saying a word and took a sip.

good.

This is Lu Daosheng's evaluation.

After all, he hasn't drunk any wine.

Although on Blue Star, the conditions are limited and the strength has been suppressed a lot.

But his experience is tangible.

Such a little wine with aura was nothing except surprise him.

In other words, this wine is no different from the wine Jiang Xiaoxiao bought in a roadside store.

Soon, after three rounds of wine.

The three old men around were all blushing and drunk.

Jiang Xiaoxiao just took a sip, so she didn't drink too much.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng also had a faint blush on his face, and he seemed to have drunk too much.

Of course, he pretended.

"Come on, keep going!"

Mr. Jiang raised his wine glass and said happily.

Hearing Mr. Jiang’s clamor, Lin Ye held the wine jar with an awkward smile on his face, and was speechless in his heart.

He knew that Mr. Jiang was an alcoholic, but he didn't know that he was so terrifying.

He vaguely remembered that this guy seemed to be smelling alcohol before he came.

That's right, the wine jar has already reached its bottom at this moment.

I just couldn't drink it anymore, but he had no channels anyway.

Looking at Lin Ye smiling awkwardly, Old Master Jiang suddenly understood, and a hint of disappointment suddenly appeared on his red old face.

He hasn't drunk enough yet.

At this time, the bodyguard of the Li family came over with a worried look on his face and supported the head of the Li family.

"Honor, you've drunk too much."

Obviously, the head of the Li family is not as good as Mr. Jiang.

At this moment, he was already a little confused.

"Go back, go home."

Before leaving, the head of the Li family smiled at Lu Daosheng.

"This little brother, if you have time, you can come to my Li family as a guest."

After saying that, the head of the Li family left the Lin family directly.

It was not until the Li family's car ran away that Jiang Xiaoxiao reacted.

"Brother Sheng, Grandpa Li and the others are gone, so how can we go?"

The two of them came by a ride.

When Lin Ye heard Jiang Xiaoxiao's words, he laughed, "Miss Jiang, don't panic. I can send someone to take you back. It's really not possible. It's not bad to live in my Lin family tonight."

It's already night now, so it's reasonable to stay here.

But Jiang Xiaoxiao kept shaking her head.

"No, no."

Until now, she has been a little unable to recover.

The main reason why the Lin family's attitude has changed too much.

It was a 180-degree turn.

She couldn't stand it if she had to live in the Lin family.

"Brother Sheng, let's go back."

Jiang Xiaoxiao held Lu Daosheng's arm and shook it gently.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded slightly.

"You take Mr. Jiang back first."

"What about you, Brother Sheng?"

Jiang Xiaoxiao frowned slightly and looked at Lu Daosheng in confusion.

Why not go back together?

Looking at Jiang Xiaoxiao who was puzzled, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I have something to deal with."

Lu Daosheng did not give any extra explanation, so Jiang Xiaoxiao had to nod.

"Oh, okay."

After so many years, Lu Daosheng is still doing what he wants, and she has long been used to it.

Supporting Mr. Jiang who was unstable, Jiang Xiaoxiao entered a luxury car under the leadership of the Lin family.

As the car started, the two of them quickly disappeared from their sight.

"Mr. Lu, are you anything else?"

Linye suppressed his drunkenness and asked carefully.

At this time, Lu Daosheng ignored Forestry and walked to the table by himself, reached out to pick up the jar of wine that had already been empty.

Looking at the wine jar for a long time, Lu Daosheng asked softly, "How much do you know about this wine?"
